statements.text: I am proud to join with Congressman Tonko to introduce the Artificial Intelligence Education Act, bipartisan legislation that will expand opportunities for artificial intelligence education in schools across our nation. [...] Educating the future leaders of America on emerging critical technologies is an important step forward in protecting our national defense, fostering ingenuity and innovation, and preparing students for the 21 st century workforce.
statements.venue: Joint press release with Rep. Paul Tonko on introducing the Artificial Intelligence Education Act
